Reviewed in-seat at tier by the dispatching seat as the compensating control for a default-tier dev, on the diff (two files, +372 / −11), the card and the head's check-runs.

### ① Derived judgments

- The checker's declaration (`:204`) is one whole-line comment in the file's existing `dispatch-gates:` marker idiom, scoped to the bare invocation, naming exactly the two step-`env:` values `lint.yml:4958–:4971` passes, with the reason stated as the file's own facts (token used when present, public board probed per number, proxy re-armed by the script; the merge-group base empty on `pull_request`, `baseSpellings` then taking the merge base against `origin/main`). The census is not declared. Matches ruling item 1.
- dispatch-gates: `local-env` joins `PATH_LIST_MARKER_KEYS`, so the shared LIST-then-reason grammar, the cut-reason refusal (#18422) and the live marker census cover it by construction rather than by a copy. `declaredLocalEnv` reads beside the two path-list readers and refuses a token that is not an env name (the `--census` lookalike is pinned). `localEnvRefusal` is one pure reading used by discovery and by the self-test: a name no step passes, a name only some steps pass, or a bare run no workflow makes, throws, and the CLI answers `derivation failed` (exit 2) — loud, naming file, line and name, in the posture the file already takes for a cut reason; a declaration the workflow outgrows cannot vouch quietly. `localEnvAdmitted` spends the declaration on the bare key alone; `--census`, `--self-test` and `check:*` keys admit nothing (pinned). `workflowEnvValues` gains a per-name limb, so an undeclared name still keeps the family out (pinned). The row carries `localEnv` in `--json` and as a same-line note in the human block (the harvest reads one line per row — kept). The docblock states the five things it does not do. Matches ruling item 2; no table, no gate, no ceiling; `package.json`, workflows and `check-required-contexts.mjs` untouched.
- Direction, not counts: the fixture pins put the bare command in `--commands` and out of the not-runnable set on the `lint.yml` step text while the census stays not-runnable on its own token; the live in-process pins do the same for `rls.zod.ts` off the discovery the self-test already holds. The roster and census pins moved to seven keys / eight declarations, each named. The measured result in the PR body: base `3f86dc52` 71 commands with both invocations NOT MEASURED; head 72 commands, the added line `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs`, only the census still NOT MEASURED, nothing else on stdout moved. Two ablations read back (declaration disabled ⇒ the bare command drops out and NOT MEASURED returns; a planted stale name ⇒ exit 2 naming `:204` and the name), both restored to the HEAD blob. Matches ruling item 3.
- Reach: PM-loop tooling and one comment line in a gate script; no runtime, spec or public surface change; CI's own commands unchanged. Second commit `15ab041f` renames a self-test fixture constant so `check:watch-hint-literal` does not read a fixture string as a live `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` declaration — the right fix (the fixture, not the gate). The two `out_of_scope_findings` are the notes already recorded by the ruling; unchanged by this PR.

### ② Semver level

Both files sit in the private root package (no `files[]`); `git grep` of the new symbols over `packages/**` and `apps/**` gives 0 hits, with `defineStack` as the positive control ⇒ no changeset; `skip-changeset` correct; consistent with `Clause-②: no`.

### ③ Boundary flags

Deviations accepted: the self-test's foreground wait past the Bash tool's budget was done by waiting on the lock holder's pid and reading the VERDICT line (`pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` through the verify lock: command-exit 0, 1976 cases; the derived sweep 33 / 33 run, 0 NOT MEASURED, a DERIVED zero at `15ab041f`); `check-dispatch-gates.mjs` not edited because its header says it runs the tool's own `--self-test` (measured); the dispatch order's line references had moved (mapped in the round-1 report). No flag remains open.
